4.8 [...] Also I'd suggest considering a less expensive subscription plan that includes some features in Pro but without unlimited Scribe. Some of us don't want AI to do our writing for us and don't need it to understand our writing style. I wouldn't pay almost $150/year for the other Pro features, but there are other nice features in Pro. I would definitely consider paying $5/month or $60 year if I could get the increased dictation length, local transcription, priority access to features, if possible unlimited Frontier Pro (if that would financially make sense at the lower subscription price point, although Frontier Mini seems pretty good), and an Android app.

#### What's great

actual, accurate dictation (6) [...] I've been using Willow Voice for about six months and Scribe for the past several months, and the experience has been outstanding. The dictation accuracy is excellent, and the Scribe AI integration is surprisingly accurate, requiring virtually no tweaking. Willow Voice probably saves me at least two hours every day by eliminating most of my typing and the need to fix typing errors. It's an amazing product that has become an essential part of my daily workflow.

#### What needs improvement

The only area I'd like to see improved is response time. It's already a great product, but making it even faster would make the experience even better. I keep getting, "Takes longer than usual," prompts.
